Class ClientModel

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am43.client.ClientModel
public class ClientModel extends Object
The ClientModel class represents the local client-side state of the game. It caches and tracks information regarding lobbies, players, cards, tracks, and game phases, providing methods to update the state and notify the UI.
